parsed.why: Most Protective tier: statewide nondiscrimination, hate-crime coverage, gender-neutral bathrooms, shield law protecting visitors, panic-defence repeal. National border, document and custody regime still binds the traveller, capping the score below low-risk.

Moderate tier: no adult facility or care ban, sodomy repealed, marriage available — but no state nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage for gender identity beyond four municipalities, and youth-care/sports restrictions via appointed boards. Above parent, thin recourse.

Worst-tier state: enacted 2025 birth-sex facility ban in state buildings, 2026 high court barring birth-certificate marker change, youth-care ban, no nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage, religious-refusal laws, possible solitary placement. Adds hostile layer below parent.

Most Protective tier: longstanding gender-identity nondiscrimination, hate-crime penalties, panic-defence repeal, shield law covering visiting patients, self-attested markers, gender-neutral single-occupancy restrooms. National entry, document and custody rules still apply, limiting but not negating the local record.

Broadest hostile layer: 2023 executive order imposing birth-sex definitions on state facilities, shelters and incarceration; school bathroom bans; birth-marker changes barred; adult care defunded in public facilities; no nondiscrimination or state hate-crime coverage. Deepest below parent.
